headline: Makati Court Issues Arrest Warrant for Rep. Leandro Leviste
seoTitle: Makati Court Issues Warrant for Rep. Leandro Leviste
seoDescription: A Makati court issued an arrest warrant for Rep. Leandro Leviste over an alleged Public Service Act violation and set bail at ₱72,000.
deck: The NBI confirmed receiving the October 5 warrant and said it would coordinate with other agencies; the charge remains unresolved.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: Makati Regional Trial Court Branch 235 issued a warrant of arrest dated October 5 for Batangas 1st District Rep. Leandro Leviste over an alleged violation of Section 25 of the Public Service Act, as amended by Republic Act 11659. Presiding Judge Ricardo A. Moldez II set bail at ₱72,000.

National Bureau of Investigation Director Melvin Matibag confirmed on October 7 that the bureau received the warrant. He said authorities would coordinate with the Bureau of Immigration on Leviste's status and whereabouts, and with the Department of Foreign Affairs on possible passport measures.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The case followed a Department of Energy complaint filed with the Department of Justice in May against Leviste and five Solar Para sa Bayan Corporation officials. The DOE alleged that the company failed to meet obligations under its legislative franchise to serve remote, unviable, unserved or underserved areas.
Leviste previously called the DOE allegations baseless. The issuance of a warrant is a court order to bring an accused before the court; it is not a finding of guilt.

sections.heading: What remains unresolved
paragraphs: GMA reported that Leviste was in France caring for his mother, Sen. Loren Legarda, who is on medical leave. The NBI said it had no confirmed return date. Leviste had not issued a new response to the warrant when the report was checked.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: The case concerns an elected lawmaker and alleged noncompliance with a franchise intended to extend electricity service to underserved communities. Court proceedings will determine whether the charge is sustained.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch whether the warrant is served, whether Leviste posts bail or challenges the case, and whether the court releases further records clarifying the charge and timetable.

audit.verificationNotes: Two independent reports reproduced key details from the court document and the NBI director confirmed receipt. The Makati court declined comment. The article states the charge as an allegation, includes Leviste's earlier denial and makes clear that a warrant is not a finding of guilt.
